sample_unit: anaesthesiology residents (compared with one ChatGPT-4 conversational LLM run)
unlisted_practices: Using an LLM as a 'cognitive safety net' to broaden differential diagnosis and guard against premature diagnostic closure, with clinicians as meta-cognitive supervisors
Condorcet social choice method to compare overall diagnostic reasoning strategies between clinicians and AI

screen.reason: The study empirically compares the diagnostic reasoning strategies of anesthesiology residents and ChatGPT-4 during a high-fidelity simulation of perioperative shock, evaluating performance and complementary reasoning profiles without directly testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
